note: Worst peak-to-trough fall per stock, with the dates, and what the index return becomes if you miss its best days. Illustrations of volatility, not strategies.

cautions.adjusted: Split and bonus adjusted, so a 1:10 split is not a 90% fall.
cautions.survivorship: Only stocks listed today are included. Delisted names are missing, which makes past falls look milder than they were.
cautions.missing_days: Assumes you held throughout and simply missed those days. It shows how concentrated returns are, not a timing strategy.
cautions.not_advice: Past drawdowns do not predict future ones.
